//: clinic_core settings for sites/<site>/site_config.json. Copy the keys you need into the REAL site_config.json -- do not rename this file over it, it would wipe db_name/encryption_key and break the site.
//developer_mode: 1 in development only. It is what allows the console OTP provider to run, and what lets request_otp report which transport was used.
//clinic_otp_provider: Which transport delivers the OTP. One of: console | null | sms | whatsapp (alias: evolution). 'console' PRINTS the code to the bench log and refuses to run when developer_mode is off.
//--- Evolution API (WhatsApp) ---: Self-hosted WhatsApp bridge. No Meta template approval is involved; the code is sent as plain text from the linked WhatsApp account.
//clinic_evolution_url: Base URL of the Evolution instance, no trailing slash. e.g. https://evo.example.com or http://192.168.1.20:8080
//clinic_evolution_api_key: The instance apikey. Sent in the 'apikey' header, never in a URL, so it does not end up in logs. KEEP THIS OUT OF THE MOBILE APP -- anyone holding it can send messages as your clinic.
//clinic_evolution_instance: The instance name you created in Evolution (the one whose WhatsApp account is linked and CONNECTED).
//clinic_evolution_verify_number: 1 (default) checks POST /chat/whatsappNumbers/{instance} before sending, so a number with no WhatsApp is refused immediately instead of silently swallowing the code. Set 0 only if that endpoint is unavailable on your build.
//clinic_evolution_timeout: Seconds to wait for Evolution, per call. Minimum 3. Keep it short -- this runs inside a web request.
//--- SMS (alternative transport) ---: Used when clinic_otp_provider is 'sms'. Configure the gateway in the SMS Settings doctype, not here.
//clinic_default_country_code: Reserved. Phone normalisation currently pins +92 (Pakistan) in clinic_core/api/v1/phone.py.
//host_name: Needed for PDF rendering; see docs. Example: http://localhost:8000
